items.title: The Third Restructuring of Software Form: From the Three-Tier Architecture to Storage, Models, and Agents
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.20201v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Software form has undergone two paradigm shifts since its inception: Software 1.0, in which instructions determine behavior, and Software 2.0, in which data determines behavior (machine learning). This paper argues that a third shift - Software 3.0, in which context and reasoning determine behavior - is now underway, and contends that its terminal form converges to three elements: a generalized database (the unified abstraction of all persistent state and memory), a large model (the intelligence core that performs reasoning and generation), and an agent (the execution loop connecting the first two). items.reason_zh: 提出软件形式第三次重构的论点，从三层架构到存储、模型与代理，具有深刻洞察和启发性。
items.summary_zh: 软件形式自诞生以来经历了两次范式转变：软件1.0中指令决定行为，软件2.0中数据决定行为（机器学习）。本文认为第三次转变——软件3.0，其中上下文和推理决定行为——正在进行中，并主张其最终形式将涉及存储、模型和代理的重新组织。这一观点对软件架构的未来发展具有深远影响。

items.title: Mechanistic Tomography: Designed Measurement for Control-Oriented Interpretability
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.19338v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability seeks quantities that models do not expose directly: represented states, component effects, interactions, and responses to interventions. Patching, gradients, Hessian-vector products, and subset interventions provide different measurements under different access assumptions and may target different quantities. We formulate their shared measurement structure as mechanistic tomography: designed measurement for recovering internal mechanisms and intervention effects.
  For a chosen basis and intervention family, measurements take the form y = Ax + w, where A describes the interventions, x is the target map, and w contains nonlinear response, sampling error, and basis misspecification. items.reason_zh: 提出机制断层扫描，为控制导向的可解释性提供设计测量框架，深化对模型内部机制的理解。
items.summary_zh: 本文提出机制断层扫描（Mechanistic Tomography），一种用于控制导向可解释性的设计测量框架。作者形式化了不同访问假设下的测量方法（如patching、梯度、Hessian-vector积等），并统一了它们的目标。通过设计实验，该方法能够更精确地揭示模型内部表示和组件效应，为干预和操控模型行为提供基础。实验证明了其在多种模型上的有效性。

items.title: DeepSeek Harness Hands-On: Four Work Modes, 'Model + Harness = Agent', and the Most Ambitious Agent Open Source of the Year
items.raw_text: DeepSeek Harness launched its developer preview and open-sourced the code at 8:30 PM on August 13. A first-night hands-on review finds the product shell still early at v0.1 but the architecture ambition the biggest of the year: four preset work modes, an everything-is-a-plugin philosophy, and the equation Model + Harness = Agent.
items.reason_zh: DeepSeek Harness 开源，四种工作模式与插件化架构，年度最具野心 Agent 开源，深度体验值得一读。
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 于 8 月 13 日晚 8:30 发布开发者预览版并开源代码。首夜体验显示产品外壳仍处于早期 v0.1 阶段，但架构野心为年度最大：四种预设工作模式、一切皆插件的理念，以及“模型 + Harness = Agent”的公式。文章详细分析了其设计思路和潜在影响。
items.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 上手体验：四种工作模式，“模型 + Harness = Agent”，年度最具野心的 Agent 开源

items.title: Nanyang Technological University, Peking University, and BAAI Release Omega-0 — A Whole-Body Action Model That Hits 81.8 Percent Success on Real Home Tasks
items.raw_text: Researchers from Nanyang Technological University, Peking University, HKUST (GZ), and Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI) released Omega-0, a latent-prediction world action model that lets a humanoid robot walk, look, and work at the same time. Single-model success on 11 real home tasks reached 81.8 percent, ahead of pi-0.5, EgoVLA, GR00T-N1.7, and psi-0.
items.reason_zh: 南洋理工、北大、智源等发布 Omega-0 全身动作模型，真实家庭任务成功率 81.8%，具突破性。
items.summary_zh: 南洋理工大学、北京大学、香港科技大学（广州）和北京智源人工智能研究院的研究人员发布了 Omega-0，一种潜在预测世界动作模型，能让机器人同时行走、观察和工作。在 11 项真实家庭任务中，单模型成功率达到 81.8%，优于 pi-0.5、EgoVLA、GR00T-N1.7 和 psi-0。
items.title_zh: 南洋理工、北大、智源发布 Omega-0——全身动作模型，真实家庭任务成功率 81.8%

items.reason_zh: 重新定义AI智能体部署单元，将Pod视为worker，提供Kubernetes上的新视角，对工程实践有启发。

items.reason_zh: 深入剖析LLM到Agent的转变，强调身体（感知与行动）的重要性，对理解Agent本质有启发。
items.summary_zh: 本文深入探讨了从大语言模型（LLM）到AI Agent的演进，指出LLM缺乏与外界交互的'身体'，即感知和行动能力。作者通过比喻说明，即使GPT-4能力强大，但若没有输入输出接口，则无法执行实际任务。文章分析了Agent需要具备的感知、记忆、工具使用等能力，并讨论了如何通过环境交互实现智能。内容具有理论深度，为理解Agent设计提供了新视角。

items.title: KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world
items.raw_text:
Turing Award winner Richard Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" for scaling large language models. The world is infinitely complex, and any simulation of it is "microscopic," with human expertise acting as a bottleneck that blocks real scaling. Sutton's alternative is agents that learn continually from their own experience instead of relying on frozen models.

The article KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world appeared first on The Decoder.
items.reason_zh: 图灵奖得主Sutton批评合成数据，提出大世界假说，对AI发展路径有深刻启示。
items.summary_zh: 图灵奖得主Richard Sutton在The Decoder的报道中称，合成数据是扩展大语言模型的“大错误”。他认为世界是无限复杂的，任何模拟都无法完全捕捉其多样性。他提出“大世界假说”，强调真实数据的重要性，对当前AI训练方法提出质疑。
items.title_zh: AI先驱Sutton称合成数据是“大错误”
